$700K Brampton home with 20% down. What is the monthly mortgage? Here is the math.

Example only, Canadian semi-annual compounding, 25-year amortization:
1) 20% down on $700,000 is $140,000.
2) $700,000 minus $140,000 leaves a $560,000 mortgage.
3) At 4.44% over 25 years, the monthly mortgage is about $3,081 (principal and interest only).
Source for the example rate: the lowest 5-year fixed rate shown on Ratehub.ca on Nov 8, 2026. Your rate depends on your down payment, lender and term. Property tax, heat and insurance are extra.

Want help working out your own budget? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

Example only. Not mortgage, tax or legal advice.

So all in, about three thousand eighty-one dollars a month, before property tax, heat and insurance.
